source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: مرة، كنت بساعد إمي بغسيل الصحون.
sentences.en: Once, I was helping my mom wash the dishes.

sentences.ar: وأنا بغسل، وقع مني فنجان قهوة وانكسر.
sentences.en: While washing, a coffee cup fell from me and broke.

sentences.ar: الفنجان كان قديم وغالي على إمي.
sentences.en: The cup was old and precious to my mom.

sentences.ar: خفت كتير وما عرفت شو أقول.
sentences.en: I got very scared and didn't know what to say.
I went to my mom and told her the truth.

sentences.ar: توقعت إنها تزعل، بس هي بس ابتسمت.
sentences.en: I expected her to be upset, but she just smiled.

sentences.ar: قالت إنه الأشيا بتنكسر، بس الصدق أهم.
sentences.en: She said things break, but honesty is more important.
I felt very relieved when I heard her words.

sentences.ar: من يومها، بحاول أكون صادق دايما.
sentences.en: Since that day, I try to always be honest.
